name: Port Kill
author: jesusarchive
description: View and stop development processes from the Omarchy bar with Port Kill.

barWidget.description: Shows running development processes. Open the menu to stop one port or all ports from 2000 through 9000.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar checks for a running Port Kill monitor and refreshes the process list. Does not change the terminal monitor interval.
